## Associated Tutorial

This workflows is part of the tutorial [Primer and primer scheme design for pan-specific detection and sequencing of viral pathogens across genotypes](https://training.galaxyproject.org/training-material/topics/sequence-analysis/tutorials/viral_primer_design/tutorial.html), available in the [GTN](https://training.galaxyproject.org)
